about: Hand-labelled (claim, quote, source) triples for measuring whether the grounding gate can tell a supporting quote from a misattributed one. Every quote here is verbatim in its source, so the old substring-only gate accepts all of them; the label is the human judgement of whether the quote actually supports the claim. Written by hand for this repo, not sampled from live traffic: it is a fixed regression set, not an estimate of field accuracy. Cases S21-S26 and M17-M28 are a second, harder batch: paraphrase positives with little word overlap, and negatives built to slip the lexical check (a swapped number that is genuinely in the quote, an entity or unit swap, a dropped hedge or quantifier).
